description: QCF V1 page fonts the app bundles, restored (not committed) by mobile/scripts/restore-mushaf-fonts.mjs from Quran Foundation's documented public CDN. Quran Foundation's Mushaf font terms allow them only as an integrated part of the app, never as a standalone download, so the .ttf files are git-ignored. Each must match its size and SHA-256 or nothing is written. © King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex.
